title.narrative: Fortalecimiento, sostenibilidad agroecológica y empresarial de cooperativas agropecuarias

description.narrative:
CONFRAS is a third-degree cooperative organisation that brings together federations and associations comprising 130 agricultural cooperatives in 11 departments of El Salvador, with around 8,760 members. The project "Strengthening the agroecological and business sustainability of agricultural cooperatives in the dry corridor of El Salvador (2025–2028)" will directly impact 500 people—including adult and young women and men—from ten cooperatives in six federations.
The project aims to strengthen the agroecological, organisational and business sustainability of agricultural cooperatives in El Salvador's dry corridor by promoting resilient production systems, inclusive management models and cooperative development strategies that contribute to food security, social equity and environmental justice. The planned actions are to improve sustainable agricultural practices, strengthen democratic governance and promote the leadership of women and young people, as well as consolidate economic and environmental management models that strengthen the viability of cooperatives.
The project will continue to support agroecological research and innovation processes through CIETTA and will include a specific component for the Women's Soil and Land Roundtable, aimed at strengthening its self-management, with a duration of one year from October 2025 to September 2026.
